effort.description: Reasoning effort. Default: Claude Code's for the model.

timeout.description: For tool and Claude nodes that set none; a gate's own timeout is separate.

caveman.description: Terse voice in chat, reports and messages. Default: on.

before.description: A program to run in the node's checkout before its session starts: if it fails, the node fails and no model turn is spent. Its prompt can read {{before.stdout}}, {{before.json.*}}.

command.description: Program and arguments (no shell), or script: instead. Supports templates.

script.description: The text of a short program, instead of command. It takes no templates: values arrive through env:, as $NAME, so a value cannot become code.

interpreter.description: What runs `script:`: a program and arguments. Default: `sh -eu`.

env.description: Environment variables for the program. Values are templates, and may read the user's own variables as {{env.NAME}}.

plainEnv.description: Variables read as {{env.NAME}} that are not secret, such as a region: their values are not masked in what programs print.

format.description: The program's result is JSON, read as output.json: the file at $ORK_OUTPUT if it wrote one, otherwise its stdout.

schema.description: The fields of that JSON a later node relies on, e.g. { state: [OPEN, CLOSED] }. A value outside these fails the node.

timeout.description: How long the program may run, e.g. 5m; then it is killed and the step fails.

rules.description: Rules for what Ork does on its own (git, permissions); they win over the project's .ork/project.yaml.

commit.description: Default: auto, Ork commits a node's work on its branch. never: Ork runs no git commit; worktrees are detached and work stays uncommitted.

merge.description: How a passing child's work reaches its owner. auto: a --no-ff merge (needs commits). patch: its changes are applied, uncommitted. never: left in its own worktree. Default: auto, or patch under commit: never.

base.description: The commit worktrees without an owner start from, e.g. origin/main. Default: HEAD. Ork never fetches.

branch.description: Branch name template over {run}, {node}, {clone} and {inputs.<name>}. Default: ork/{run}/{node}.

worktrees.description: Worktree folder template, relative to the clone, beside it. Default: ../{clone}-worktrees/ork-{run}-{node}.

permissions.description: Tool rules every Claude node gets on top of its own, e.g. deny: ['Bash(git push *)'].

only.description: The only built-in tools the session has; Ork's tools stay.

links.description: Default: on, the user can link a running node to a node of another run. off: its nodes get no message tools unless they have someone to write to, and cannot be linked.

agents.description: Agents defined in this workflow; they win over the project's and the user's of the same name.

description.description: When to use this agent; tools show it when choosing one.

instructions.description: The agent's role, appended to the system prompt of its nodes.

effort.description: Reasoning effort. Default: Claude Code's for the model.

timeout.description: How long the node may work, e.g. 30m; time waiting on the user does not count.

caveman.description: Terse voice in chat, reports and messages. Default: on.

only.description: The only built-in tools the session has; Ork's tools stay.

session.description: When the node runs again (a loop, another delegation): resume its session, or start a fresh one with the new input. Default: resume for a leader, fresh for a worker.

schema.description: Extra structured fields the node must report, e.g. { verdict: [approve, escalate] }.

budgetUsd.description: Hard cap for the whole run.

timeout.description: How long the whole run may work, e.g. 2h; time waiting on the user does not count.

workflow.description: The workflow's name, as in its project's workflows folder.

project.description: A registered project's id. Default: this project.

node.description: A leader or worker of the called workflow to talk to and wait on; the call then keeps one run as a conversation.

inputs.description: The called workflow's inputs. Supports templates.

wait.description: When this node finishes: the run has ended (default without `node`), the node has reported (default with `node`), or as soon as the run has started.

ref.description: What the called run's worktrees start from, e.g. {{nodes.build.output.branch}}.

timeout.description: How long the call may take, e.g. 30m; then the called run is stopped and the node fails.

maxMessages.description: Ask the user whether to go on after this many messages.

parent.description: Owner of this node in the ownership tree.

server.description: The server's name in the project's `.mcp.json`.

tool.description: The tool to call on it.

arguments.description: The tool's arguments. Strings are templates; one that is only {{ … }} keeps its value's type.

schema.description: The fields of the tool's JSON result a later node relies on, e.g. { state: [open, closed] }. A value outside these fails the node.

plainEnv.description: Variables read as {{env.NAME}} that are not secret, such as a region: their values are not masked in what programs print.

watch.description: Call the tool again and again until a condition holds, with no model turn.

every.description: How long to wait between looks, e.g. 30s. At least 5s.

until.description: Stop looking when this holds. It reads what an edge's when: does.

timeout.description: How long to go on looking, e.g. 2h; then the node fails. Time between looks doesn't count against limits.timeout.

misses.description: How many failed looks in a row end the wait, such as a network error. Default: 3.
